rubric: Exact query-result relevance: primary requires complete explicit, publication-eligible child, or bounded source-grounded authoritative scope; broader lacks one major established dimension; incidental or partial evidence is rejected.

movement_clusters.reason: Every missed required anchor is recovered through query-role interpretation, source-grounded scope, or the corrected complete-intent verifier; no recovery is ranking-only or semantic-only.
EWRE explicitly publishes chemical resource recovery plus recycling and management of critical minerals; exact query-result judgments were added without rewriting either spent holdout.
TCUP supplies complete innovation/student-success scope and CICI supplies complete AI-science-workflow security/resilience scope.
MFAI establishes foundation models and trustworthy AI but not the security/adversarial dimension; it remains separate from primary.
A posted FY2012 notice with no current close, archive, or rolling evidence is rejected by a generic search-v2 currentness guard.
A plasma program combined the generic verb 'builds' with 'decarbonized' 60 tokens later; the generic concise-intent coherence window was tightened from 72 to 48 tokens.
A broad AI umbrella combined parent biology text with an unrelated quantum-sensing child; parent-child aggregation now requires a non-generic bridge grounded in the parent title and child source.
Building decarbonization retains two explicit NYSERDA programs, crop improvement gains a current crop-protection/improvement notice, and hypersonics retains only the two explicitly scoped programs.
